people.name: Abilene
people.line: A region ruled by Lysanias when John began preaching.

people.name: Augustus
people.line: Roman emperor during the birth of Jesus

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Herod
people.line: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

people.name: Jetur
people.line: A descendant of Ishmael and a region in Syria

people.name: Judea
people.line: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem

people.name: Lysanias
people.line: Tetrarch of Abilene during John the Baptist's ministry

people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

people.name: Tiberius

people.name: Trachonitis

translations.web: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
